description: This file defines the enum VoiceOverlayTextFormatting with static methods to process and style voice overlay text, including delta calculations and attributed string creation.

methods.name: delta(after:current:)
methods.description: Calculates the difference between the committed and current strings, returning the new part after the committed prefix.

methods.name: makeAttributed(committed:volatile:isFinal:)
methods.description: Creates an attributed string combining committed and volatile text with different styles based on the isFinal flag.
